heldOutReviewCases.objective: Candidate uses Arven to access Field Blower and Stealthy Hood; test Eri timing, Tool Jammer blanking and Faba follow-up.
Candidate uses Unfair Stamp; test Eri timing and preservation of rank-3 recovery Supporters.
Candidate uses Acerola to remove its Active Pokémon; test re-establishing Snorlax Block without breaking own lock.
Candidate rotates Stealthy Hood, Float Stone and Forest Seal Stone; test Faba target order and Tool Jammer timing.
Full-turn Articuno Water Energy setup and Cold Crush-GX timing against actual board transitions.
Gladion and Hisuian Heavy Ball with public versus hidden prize identities; never guess hidden identities.
Candidate alternates Sky Field and Dimension Valley; test Beach versus Temple and turn-ending draw timing.
Compare Burrow, Get Lost, Rototiller and Collapse while tracking both deck counts and lock integrity.

unresolvedCoverage: No native Twinleaf Store receipt for any case.
